2609.07984.title: From Event Logs to Governed Action: A BlueSky Agenda for Agentic Process Mining
2609.07984.paper_summary: Process mining has long turned event logs into process knowledge: discovered models, conformance evidence, bottleneck diagnoses, and runtime predictions. Agentic AI changes the target. Process-aware agents will not only ask what happened. They will ask whether a proposed action should be taken, given the available evidence, privacy budget, organizational authority, and downstream risk. This BlueSky paper proposes event-to-action process mining: a process-mining agenda for transforming heterogeneous operational event data into governed action. The goal is not another dashboard, a generic enterprise simulator, or a language interface over logs. We argue that the community needs four mineable artifacts: event-object representations, action evidence packages, governance contracts, and benchmarks where act, defer, ask, and refuse are all valid outputs. This agenda is timely because agentic business process management (BPM), LLM-assisted process mining, object-centric event standards, causal process monitoring, and privacy-preserving learning are maturing separately. Bringing them together defines a data-mining target inside process mining: mining logged organizational behavior for accountable action, not only retrospective insight.
2609.07984.paper_summary_zh: 流程挖掘長期以來將事件日誌轉化為流程知識：發現模型、一致性證據、瓶頸診斷和運行時預測。代理型人工智慧改變了目標。具備流程意識的代理不僅會詢問發生了什麼。他們會根據可用的證據、隱私預算、組織權限和下游風險詢問是否應採取建議的行動。這篇BlueSky論文提出了事件到行動的流程挖掘：一個將異構操作事件數據轉化為受管控行動的流程挖掘議程。目標不是另一個儀表板、一個通用的企業模擬器或一個基於日誌的語言介面。我們認為社群需要四種可挖掘的工件：事件-對象表示、行動證據包、治理合約，以及行動、延遲、詢問和拒絕都是有效輸出的基準。這個議程是及時的，因為代理型業務流程管理（BPM）、大型語言模型輔助的流程挖掘、以對象為中心的事件標準、因果流程監控和隱私保護學習正在各自成熟。將它們結合起來定義了流程挖掘中的數據挖掘目標：挖掘記錄的組織行為以實現負責任的行動，而不僅僅是回顧性的洞察。
